title: Pluperfect and Future Perfect
subtitle: amāveram, amāverō. Auxiliary endings on the perfect stem.
objectives: Form pluperfect and future perfect from the perfect stem.
Understand the perfect system as three tenses sharing one stem.

sections.heading: Pluperfect and future perfect
sections.body:
Pluperfect (had -ed): amāveram, amāverās, amāverat, amāverāmus, amāverātis, amāverant

Future perfect (will have -ed): amāverō, amāveris, amāverit, amāverimus, amāveritis, amāverint

Caesar writes: mīlitēs iam discesserant. — The soldiers had already departed.

items.answer: dūxeram, dūxerās, dūxerat, dūxerāmus, dūxerātis, dūxerant
